posts.text: 0,2 usd i utbytte. Som betales ut 2. desember. Commercial update: In October 2026, Himalaya Shipping Ltd. (“Himalaya,” or the “Company”) achieved average time charter equivalent (“TCE”) earnings of approximately US$50,900 per day, gross[1], including average daily scrubber benefits of approximately US$1,900 per day. The Company’s eight vessels trading on index-linked time charters earned approximately US$49,300 per day, gross, including average daily scrubber benefits. The Company’s four vessels trading on fixed time charters earned approximately US$53,900 per day, gross, including average daily scrubber benefits.  The Baltic 5TC 180 Capesize Index averaged US$33,254 during October 2026. Cash dividend: The Board has approved a cash dividend of US$0.20 per share for October 2026
